cohort: 85 mothers and their healthy, term newborns
finding: Oxidative stress markers were elevated in mothers and newborns immediately after birth and increased further during the first few days of neonatal life, while breast milk showed high antioxidant activity and decreased TBARS levels, suggesting a protective role against oxidative stress.
mod_finding: Markers of oxidative stress and antioxidant capacity were independent of the mode of delivery.
